items.label: U.S. House (special election)
items.text: Won the August 18, 2026 special general election for California's 14th Congressional District to fill the remainder of the term of Eric Swalwell, who resigned effective April 14, 2026; the AP called the race on August 20, 2026. Unofficial Secretary of State returns showed 53.1% to 46.9% over Melissa Hernandez. (sources: KTVU https://www.ktvu.com/news/aisha-wahab-wins-california-district-14-special-election [search summary, secondary]; NBC Bay Area https://www.nbcbayarea.com/news/local/aisha-wahab-california-congressional-district-14/4130964/ [search summary, secondary]; California Secretary of State https://electionresults.sos.ca.gov/special/us-rep/district/14 [search summary, primary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_California%27s_14th_congressional_district_special_election [search summary, secondary])

items.label: California State Senate
items.text: Member of the California State Senate, 10th District, from December 5, 2022; Wikipedia lists the tenure as ending September 1, 2026. Appointed Senate assistant majority leader in 2025. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aisha_Wahab [search summary, secondary]; Ballotpedia https://ballotpedia.org/Aisha_Wahab [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Hayward City Council
items.text: Elected to an at-large seat on the Hayward City Council in November 2018 and served 2018 to 2022; mayor pro tempore in 2020. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aisha_Wahab [search summary, secondary]; California State University, East Bay https://csueastbay.edu/news-center/2019/03/one-of-the-first.html [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
items.text: B.A., San Jose State University (JoinCalifornia lists Political Science, 2010); M.B.A., California State University, East Bay; doctorate from the University of Southern California (Wikipedia lists a Doctor of Social Work; JoinCalifornia lists a Ph.D., 2024). (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aisha_Wahab [search summary, secondary]; JoinCalifornia https://joincalifornia.com/candidate/14990 [search summary, secondary]; California State University, East Bay https://csueastbay.edu/news-center/2019/03/one-of-the-first.html [search summary, secondary])

items.label: BART Board of Directors
items.text: Member of the BART Board of Directors, District 5: appointed in May 2024 to fill a vacancy and elected in November 2024. Elected board president for 2026. (sources: Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) https://www.bart.gov/node/11700 [search summary, primary]; Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) https://www.bart.gov/node/44806 [search summary, primary]; Pleasanton Weekly https://www.pleasantonweekly.com/transportation/2024/05/23/dublin-mayor-chosen-to-fill-tri-valley-bart-board-vacancy/ [search summary, secondary])

items.label: City of Dublin
items.text: Elected to the Dublin City Council in 2016; vice mayor 2018 to 2019; elected mayor of Dublin in 2020 and served until June 2024, when she left the post after joining the BART board. (sources: Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) https://www.bart.gov/node/11700 [search summary, primary]; Local News Matters https://localnewsmatters.org/2020/11/06/hernandez-garners-more-than-half-the-vote-in-dublin-mayors-race/ [search summary, secondary]; Patch https://patch.com/california/dublin/new-mayor-sworn-dublin-after-hernandez-joins-bart-board [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Regional transportation boards
items.text: Has served on the Alameda County Transportation Commission and has chaired the Livermore Amador Valley Transit Authority and a Tri-Valley/San Joaquin Valley regional transit authority. (sources: Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) https://www.bart.gov/node/11700 [search summary, primary])

items.label: Education
items.text: Degree in political science and public administration (one profile: Political Science, Public Affairs and Administration) from California State University, East Bay; graduation year not stated. (sources: Ava Community Energy https://avaenergy.org/from-the-ceos-desk/faces-of-ebce-board-member-melissa-hernandez-of-dublin/ [search summary, secondary]; BOLD PAC https://www.boldpac.com/candidates/melissa-hernandez [search summary, secondary])
